label: Guide me - Agent & MCP

params.name: lede
params.default: Let Claude Code on your laptop press {product}'s buttons for you, for tests and demos, while sign-ins and payments stay with people.
params.label: lede

default.title: The road
default.say: Claude Code on your laptop sends your owner key with every call. {product} checks that the key is still yours, then presses the same buttons you would.

default.title: Your owner key
default.say: Your key lives here. {product} keeps only its fingerprint and its last four characters, never the key itself.

default.title: Make your key
default.say: Click Make my key. The key appears once, inside the one line you paste on your laptop. A new key stops the old one at once.

default.title: Add it to Claude Code
default.say: Paste that line in a terminal on your laptop. Then ask Claude Code to check {product} status.

default.title: What Claude may do
default.say: Every tool is one of your own buttons, checked as you. Search finds a tool even when misspelt.

default.title: Steps that stay with people
default.say: Signing in, passwords, accepting permissions and payments stay with people. Claude is told which step is next, and never tries it.
